fato_historico: 1903: Black Saturday occurs, killing 12 in a stadium collapse in Philadelphia.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reinforce the structures of your life, Capricorn. Just as history reminds us that even the grandest arenas require solid grounds to hold the weight of joy, you may find it a good time to strengthen your personal foundations. Consider building your plans with patience, ensuring your dreams stand tall against any unforeseen shifts.
frase_do_dia: Build your future on a foundation of steady faith and resilient hope.
significado_numero: The symbol of infinite possibilities and balanced material abundance.
conselho: Focus on fortifying your current path before starting a new ambitious project.
